messages:
deploy-bot: AUTO-HOLD: rollout v2.7.1 -> us-west triggered rollback_gate: release_notes:missing_fields. Holding traffic at 60%. logs: https://deploys.internal/release/2.7.1/logs :warning:

jamal: saw the hold, what's missing exactly? is this the new checklist enforcement?

priya: yes — the release notes template requires `breaking_changes` and `migration_steps`. missing `migration_steps` triggered the gate. :memo:

liam: metrics look fine (p95 unchanged, error rate steady). the gate is policy-driven — automated bypass requires approvals.

ashley: we have a small user-facing schema change that needs the migration steps called out. i'd rather fix notes than bypass. ETA to patch notes?

jamal: i can add a minimal `migration_steps` bullet and link to the PR. should be ~7m. once updated, can we resume?

sre-runbook-bot: resume checklist: 1) release_notes updated in main branch 2) operator runs `/resume rollout <version>` 3) observe canary for 15m. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/release-gates

jamal: creating PR now — will include minimal steps and link to our upgrade guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/812

deploy-bot: HOLD state still active. reason=missing_release_notes_field. waiting for artifact: `release_notes/v2.7.1.md` to pass validation. last_check: release_notes=FAIL

priya: @jamal when you add it, please also tag `release-eng` in the PR so reviewers get the notif. downstream ingestion expects `migration_v2` metadata too.

jamal: merged -> release_notes/v2.7.1.md now includes `migration_steps` + link to upgrade doc. https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/commit/5b7c9d

deploy-bot: DETECT: release_notes check => PASS. Auto-unhold disabled by policy; operator confirmation required. To proceed run: ```/resume rollout 2.7.1``` (requires operator role)

liam: approving from SRE: `/approve-sre jamal` :thumbsup:

ashley: customer comms drafted, holding until rollout completes or if rollback happens. i'll send an interim note if we hit errors.

jamal: executing resume now:
```
/resume rollout 2.7.1
```

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout resumed. traffic: 60% -> 85% over 10m. monitoring window: 15m p95/errors. rollback automation remains armed. notify if p95 + error spikes > threshold. :eyes:

liam: i'll keep a watch and standby. if anything looks off we escalate and run `/rollback rollout 2.7.1 --to 2.7.0`

ashley: thanks team — keeping customers in the loop.

jamal: closing thread once we hit 100% or we trigger rollback.
